entries.title: The art of saying it well
entries.odia: କହି ଜାଣିଲେ କଥା ସୁନ୍ଦର ବାନ୍ଧି ଜାଣିଲେ ମଥା ସୁନ୍ଦର
entries.literal_meaning: Know how to speak, and words are beautiful; know how to arrange hair, and the head is beautiful.
entries.explanation: How something is done matters. Well-chosen words are compared with hair arranged by a practised hand.
entries.meaning_odia: କଥା କହିବାର ଢଙ୍ଗ ଜାଣିଲେ କଥା ଭଲ ଲାଗେ; କେଶ ସଜାଇବା ଜାଣିଲେ ମଥା ସୁନ୍ଦର ଦିଶେ। ଉଭୟରେ କୌଶଳର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଅଛି।
entries.usage_example: A colleague makes a difficult request gently and clearly, helping everyone respond. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary places this under arranging hair and labels it ଢଗ. The comparison concerns skill, not a rule about personal appearance.

entries.title: Little rest, many troubles
entries.odia: ଅଳପ ନିଦକୁ ବହୁତ କଥା, ଝୁରିମରିବାକୁ କଲା ବିଧାତା
entries.literal_meaning: Little sleep, so much happening; fate has made me pine away.
entries.explanation: A weary complaint that troubles leave little rest. The exaggerated lament carries the feeling of being overwhelmed.
entries.meaning_odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ଅଳ୍ପ, ହେଲେ ଚିନ୍ତା ଓ ଘଟଣାର ଶେଷ ନାହିଁ—ଏମିତି କ୍ଲାନ୍ତିର ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଏଠାରେ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ।
entries.usage_example: After several demanding days, someone sighs that even bedtime brings another worry. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary cites this under happening/event. This is an editorial reading of its lament, not sleep advice.

entries.title: A meal ends; its reputation remains
entries.literal_meaning: One day’s rice; ages of reputation.
entries.explanation: A brief occasion can leave a lasting impression, good or bad. Its memory outlasts the meal.
entries.meaning_odia: ଭୋଜନ ଦିନକର, କିନ୍ତୁ ସେହି ଅବସରର ଭଲମନ୍ଦ ନାମ ବହୁଦିନ ରହିପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: Guests remember a host’s considerate welcome long after the gathering ends. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary places କଥା here under fame or notoriety and labels the saying ପ୍ରବଚନ. No particular feast is identified.
